## Fixes

- C# groups now preserve member errors when an already-ended member cancels other members during group creation.
- Cancelling C# tweens with `includeChildren: true` now allows cancellation callbacks to free the owner node.
- C# playback starts now reject disposal during a custom binding's `Copy()` hook, instead of returning a handle that never finishes.
- C# scalar, vector and rectangle interpolation now handles finite endpoints near opposite numeric limits without overflowing their difference, matching the GDScript backend.

Regression tests cover these cases, with shared group and interpolation fixtures for both languages.

## Downloads

- **Godot addon:** `tweens.gd-0.2.4-beta.zip` includes C# and GDScript sources, stable UIDs, and prebuilt native libraries. Requires Godot 4.7 or later (tested with 4.7.2); C# additionally requires Godot .NET and .NET 8 or later. GDScript-only projects do not require .NET.
- **Standalone tutorial:** `tweens.gd-tutorial.zip` includes the complete tutorial project, export presets and the 0.2.4-beta addon. Requires Godot .NET 4.7.2 and the .NET 8 SDK or later.
- **Compiled C# package:** `tweens.gd.0.2.4-beta.nupkg`, targeting .NET 8 and .NET 10, with symbols in `tweens.gd.0.2.4-beta.snupkg`.

**Full changelog:** [v0.2.3-beta…v0.2.4-beta](https://github.com/outfox/tweens.gd/compare/v0.2.3-beta...v0.2.4-beta)
